surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted filename string and trusted reports_root string.
TRUST: reports_root is the approved boundary; filename is untrusted user input that must resolve to a path strictly inside it.
SINK: Open and read the resolved target as UTF-8 text.
GUARD: Per [filesystem_links], reject with ValueError if the resolved path escapes reports_root. Reject with ValueError if any user-selected path component is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root. If the resolved, allowed, symlink-free path does not exist, propagate FileNotFoundError; if it exists but is not an ordinary file, raise ValueError.
ORDER: Resolve filename against reports_root and validate strict subpath containment. Inspect each user-selected path component for symbolic links. Verify the target is an ordinary file or propagate FileNotFoundError if missing. Read UTF-8 contents.
EFFECT: Return the file contents as str when the path is contained, symlink-free, and an existing ordinary file; raise ValueError for escapes, symlink components, or non-ordinary targets; propagate FileNotFoundError only for missing ordinary files that pass all guards.
END_PLAN
